items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: And so we got a fellow called Thomas.

ctx.x: We had Earl. So Earl he left and he went away. And so we got a fellow called Thomas. Sorry I can't think of Thomas. He died three years ago. We got Thomas. And the band was playing real good, really good. So Kid Rene, he had the hottest jazz band around town.
